Q3 2026 Market Recap: Energy Up, Utilities Crushed, and Software Flipped | The Weekly Wrap

Eisman reviews third-quarter sector rotation, rising rates and the growing AI concentration of stock and bond portfolios. He discloses covering his FICO short and selling Glass House, recommends short Treasuries for money intended to avoid AI exposure, and emphasizes utility cost-recovery risks. The warning about hidden factor concentration is useful, but sector membership is not a measured AI beta. His assertion that repo uses only Treasuries is factually wrong.

  • Use position sizing and exits when the information picture deteriorates.
